text: Study the breast_cancer dataset: run an autoresearch study with 12 experiments, inspect why things were accepted or rejected, and write the report.

name: research_load_dataset
content:
Loaded breast_cancer: 569 rows, 30 numeric features, 2 classes.
Training set: 426 rows (class 0: 159, class 1: 267).
Held-out set: 143 rows — withheld from the search, scored once at the end.
Protocol: 3x5-fold repeated stratified CV, scoring=balanced_accuracy.

name: research_search_space
content:
Preprocessors: none, standard, minmax, quantile, power, pca

Models and parameters:
  logreg — C: [0.01, 0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 5.0, 20.0, 100.0]; penalty: ['l2']
  sgd — loss: ['hinge', 'log_loss', 'modified_huber']; alpha: [1e-05, 0.0001, 0.001, 0.01]
  svc — C: [0.1, 1.0, 5.0, 20.0, 100.0]; kernel: ['rbf', 'linear', 'poly']; gamma: ['scale', 'auto', 0.01, 0.1]
  knn — n_neighbors: [1, 3, 5, 9, 15, 25]; weights: ['uniform', 'distance']; p: [1, 2]
  tree — max_depth: [2, 3, 5, 8, None]; min_samples_leaf: [1, 2, 5, 10]; criterion: ['gini', 'entropy']
  forest — n_estimators: [100, 300, 600]; max_depth: [None, 5, 10, 20]; min_samples_leaf: [1, 2, 4]; max_features: ['sqrt', 'log2', None]
  extratrees — n_estimators: [100, 300, 600]; max_depth: [None, 8, 16]; min_samples_leaf: [1, 2, 4]
  gboost — n_estimators: [100, 200]; learning_rate: [0.03, 0.1, 0.2]; max_depth: [2, 3, 5]; subsample: [0.7, 1.0]
  histgboost — learning_rate: [0.03, 0.1, 0.2]; max_iter: [100, 300]; max_leaf_nodes: [15, 31, 63]; l2_regularization: [0.0, 1.0]
  mlp — hidden_layer_sizes: [(32,), (64,), (128,), (64, 32)]; alpha: [0.0001, 0.001, 0.01]; learning_rate_init: [0.001, 0.01]
  gnb — var_smoothing: [1e-09, 1e-07, 1e-05]
  lda — solver: ['svd', 'lsqr']

Scale-sensitive models (svc, knn, mlp, logreg, sgd) usually need a scaler. Tree ensembles are invariant to monotone scaling.

name: research_set_protocol
content: Protocol set: alpha=0.05, min_effect=0.002, 3x5-fold repeated stratified CV (15 fits per experiment).

name: research_run_study
content:
Study 'agent-breast_cancer' finished: 12 experiments in 201.9s (180 model fits).
Verdicts: 2 accepted, 1 inconclusive, 9 rejected

SELECTED: standard+logreg
  validation 0.9741 ± 0.0211
  held-out   0.9850  (scored once, after selection)
  selection gap -0.0109

For comparison, a greedy loop keeping the best validation score would have chosen standard+logreg (validation 0.9741, held-out 0.9850).

Top 5 by validation score:
  1. 0.9741  standard+logreg  [accepted]
  2. 0.9707  standard+mlp  [rejected]
  3. 0.9670  standard+svc  [rejected]
  4. 0.9636  none+extratrees  [rejected]
  5. 0.9600  none+histgboost  [rejected]

Ledger: runs/agent-breast_cancer-ledger.jsonl
Call research_inspect_ledger for the reasoning behind any verdict, or research_write_report to produce the write-up.
